documents.title: Refund Policy
documents.body: Customers may request a full refund within 30 days of purchase. After 30 days, store credit only.

documents.title: Shipping SLA
documents.body: Standard shipping delivers in 5-7 business days. Express shipping delivers in 1-2 business days.

documents.title: Support Hours
documents.body: Live chat support is available Monday through Friday, 9am to 6pm Pacific Time.

documents.title: Enterprise Plan
documents.body: The Enterprise plan includes SSO, audit logs, and a dedicated account manager. Minimum 50 seats.

documents.title: API Rate Limits
documents.body: Free tier: 100 requests per minute. Pro tier: 1000 requests per minute. Enterprise: custom limits.

documents.title: Data Retention
documents.body: User activity logs are retained for 90 days. Audit logs for Enterprise customers are retained for 1 year.

documents.title: Password Requirements
documents.body: Passwords must be at least 12 characters and include uppercase, lowercase, a number, and a symbol.

documents.title: Incident Response
documents.body: P0 incidents require acknowledgment within 15 minutes and executive notification within 1 hour.
